purpose: Second governed backfill containing durable DigitalGate business context recoverable from authorised project conversation context. These records are review candidates, not automatically approved truth.
limitations: Historical conversations are not exposed as a complete transcript archive by the available tooling. This seed captures recoverable durable context only. Time-sensitive or potentially superseded commercial facts must be reviewed before approval.

items.title: DigitalGate business focus
items.statement: DigitalGate is a web-based marketing and business platform business with a strong focus on lead generation, websites, SEO, AI, automation and connected business operations for SMEs.

items.title: Platform vision
items.statement: DigitalGate aims to become an intelligent business platform that helps owners run their businesses better and smarter by connecting operational context, understanding what matters and proactively helping them act.

items.title: DigitalGate-owned dogfood businesses
items.statement: DigitalGate dogfoods the platform across DigitalGate itself and related operating businesses including Roe Realty, Currumbin Valley Hideaway and Aëtherra, each represented as a separate organisation/tenant rather than merged into one business record.

items.title: Real Estate as an early proving ground
items.statement: Roe Realty is an important DigitalGate dogfood and proving-ground organisation for CRM, vendor lead generation, appraisals, listings and Real Estate industry workflows.

items.title: Accommodation as an early proving ground
items.statement: Currumbin Valley Hideaway is an important DigitalGate dogfood organisation for native Gen 2 accommodation, bookings, guests, calendars, housekeeping, OTA/iCal workflows and direct-booking growth.

items.title: CVH is native Gen 2
items.statement: Currumbin Valley Hideaway has completed its architectural cutover to native Gen 2 and must not depend on WordPress for normal production runtime.

items.title: SME owner outcome orientation
items.statement: DigitalGate should be positioned around business outcomes — finding customers, converting opportunities, operating efficiently, getting paid, retaining customers and making better decisions — rather than exposing a list of disconnected software features.

items.title: Real Estate initial outbound market
items.statement: A previous DigitalGate go-to-market focus has been boutique Real Estate agencies in the Southern Gold Coast, using lead generation and visibility systems as an entry point. Treat this as a reviewable market strategy rather than permanent platform scope.

items.title: Named Real Estate marketing frameworks
items.statement: DigitalGate has developed or discussed branded Real Estate growth frameworks including AI Visibility Framework™, Appraisal Magnet System™, Listing Pipeline Framework™ and Vendor Velocity System™.

items.title: Gen 2 web platform stack
items.statement: DigitalGate Gen 2 is a Next.js multi-tenant platform using Clerk for identity/authentication, PostgreSQL on Neon for Platform Core data and Stripe for platform billing/payments where applicable.

items.title: Connector strategy
items.statement: DigitalGate should connect specialist business systems such as payments, accounting, Google/Microsoft communications, advertising, ecommerce, telephony and industry software so their context can improve Business Brain reasoning and automation.

items.title: Accounting should generally be integrated, not rebuilt
items.statement: DigitalGate should generally integrate and understand mature accounting systems rather than rebuilding a full general ledger, BAS, payroll and bank-reconciliation product; DigitalGate's differentiation is interpreting financial signals in the wider business context and helping the owner act.

items.title: Platform pillars
items.statement: DigitalGate's core platform story is Connect, Centralise, Understand, Automate and Grow, with Core services and Apps sharing a common intelligence and automation foundation.

items.title: Shared AI Service
items.statement: The platform architecture includes a shared AI Service with reusable prompt/context/tool/model-routing capabilities so Apps do not each build isolated AI stacks.

items.title: Shared Scoring Engine
items.statement: DigitalGate uses a shared scoring model for capabilities such as AI Visibility Score™, SEO Score™, Website Health Score™ and Business Health/Growth signals rather than isolated app-specific scoring logic where a shared foundation is appropriate.

items.title: Industry apps extend Platform Core
items.statement: Industry Apps such as Real Estate, Accommodation, Finance and Services add specialised context and workflows while reusing canonical Platform Core contacts, companies, opportunities, tasks, communications, payments, documents and events.

items.title: Business Brain compounds across connected objects
items.statement: Business Brain should compound knowledge across Contacts, Companies, Opportunities, Tasks, Communications, Documents, Websites, Payments, Bookings, Activities, integrations, automation outcomes and approved organisational knowledge rather than reason from isolated app data.

items.title: DigitalGate should learn from outcomes
items.statement: Recommendations and automations should eventually be measured against resulting business outcomes so DigitalGate can learn which interventions actually help each organisation rather than repeatedly offering generic advice.

items.title: Production changes are controlled
items.statement: DigitalGate production remediation should inspect/read-only first, use branches and pull requests, run appropriate tests and migrations, and verify production after changes rather than performing uncontrolled production mutations.

items.title: Architecture boundary matters more than string counts
items.statement: Legacy WordPress migration capability should not be deleted merely to achieve a zero-string-count audit result. The requirement is that normal native Gen 2 operation has no WordPress dependency while useful migration capability remains isolated at the connector boundary.

items.title: My Venue Clean opportunity
items.statement: My Venue Clean has been discussed as a DigitalGate customer opportunity involving website improvement, platform onboarding and potentially a later second website/business line for venue services or maintenance. This should be reconciled with current CRM status before approval.

items.title: AIM Financial opportunity
items.statement: AIM Financial has been discussed as a significant DigitalGate opportunity for a managed platform/website/CRM solution, with interest in reducing fragmented manual work and integrating specialist finance systems. Current commercial status must be checked in CRM before approval.

items.title: Turn strong product thinking into Insights
items.statement: When platform work produces a genuinely differentiated business/product insight, DigitalGate should capture it as an Insight candidate for the public website rather than allowing the idea to disappear inside development conversations.
